periods.time: Evening after Bell learns his Little Rookie title
periods.location: Back alleys near Hestia Familia's ruined church
periods.summary: After Bell leaves for his celebration, several gods who had searched or staked out Hestia's hidden headquarters surround him, try to recruit him, and push for the secret behind his record growth until Bell flees at full speed.
periods.cause: Bell's unprecedented Lv.2 promotion and public Little Rookie title make him a target for divine curiosity and poaching.
periods.process: The gods praise, proposition, and interrogate Bell, asking if his growth comes from physique, skill, fraud, or a rare skill; some even suggest stripping him to inspect his back.
periods.outcome: Bell panics and escapes through the alleys before reaching the Hostess of Fertility late and exhausted.
periods.aftermath: Bell experiences firsthand the new attention caused by his level-up.
periods.significance: Shows Bell's changed public environment after Denatus: fame now brings predatory divine attention.
